findings.remediation: Maintainers decide the review framing for a pre-existing immutable artifact: architecture review of the record as submitted, or closure with a stated reason.
findings.summary: The described hook exists immutably on Ethereum mainnet with owner address(0); this application is an authorized flagship reference of that artifact, and no contract change of any kind is possible or proposed.

findings.remediation: The token and NFT sources are now bound byte-exactly in the flagship closure, and the seller-exit suite exercises ordinary transfers, 0/1/16/>16 retirements, holder-only batch preparation, complete exit with no third party, allowance paths and atomic failure against those exact sources; review those bindings.
findings.summary: The paired ERC-20 couples outflows to an NFT dormancy layer with a bounded 16-retirement work limit; a larger unprepared transfer reverts PreparationRequired until the holder self-serves prepareSell, while amounts are never modified and buys are never affected.

findings.remediation: Maintainers decide whether a future fee-integrated variant, which would be a new deployment with its own source and review, is in scope for this application id or belongs to a separate application.
findings.summary: The mandatory Programmable volume-fee policy is not implemented by the described immutable hook and cannot be retrofitted into it, so fee collection remains pending-hook-integration permanently for this instance.
